page.layout: One printed page of running text, with two marginal notes in the left margin at the top. Running head above the text, page number at the head, catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: Christus ipse totum cū suis beneficiis est res illa in Sacramentis significata & præbita.Q[?]VÆ res in sacra Domini Cœna, partim materialibus illis signis duobus, partim ritibus illis religiosis, diuinitus mandatis Sacramentaliter, id est, addita illarum verę præbitionis promissione, significetur, ex superiore tractatione intelligi plenissimè potest: Christus ipse nimirum, sese, cum suis omnibus beneficiis, spiritualiter mentibus nostris, per fidem magis ac magis apprehendendum, & vtendum fruendum, non minus verè præbens, quàm verè signa illa corporaliter & organis corporeis percipienda traduntur.

Error eorū refellitur, qui solum Christi obedientiæ meritum pro re in Sacra Domini Cœna significari docent.In hanc veritatem peccant,& quidem gravissimè,qui pro ipsa essentiali Christi humanitate ( quæ est omnium quæ pro nobis redimendis subiit,subiectum,& per quam nobis, sicuti suo loco explicabimus, communicata vita illa spiritualis in credentes defluit) solum ipsius obedientiæ meritum, contendunt in sacra Domini Cœna, pane illo & vino illo,significari.Verètur enim ne si ipsum illud corpus, & ipsum illum Christi sanguinem, in hac actione significari,& nobis verè præberi, statuatur,realis quoq; in terris Christi humanitati,tum præsentia, tum cum panis & vini substantiis coniunctio, atque adeò in ipsa corpora nostra traiectio,ponantur. Et fatendum quidem est, hæc monstra necessario Transsubstantiationis &Consubstantiationis dogma consequi.Sed non propterea fuit ipse Chri-

page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of the first paragraph is decorative; its first letter is read as Q and is uncertain. Left margin: two notes, both transcribed in full. Some words at line ends are hyphenated in print ("re-ligiosis", "de-fluit", "huma-nitate"). The catchword "Chri-" is at the foot right.
